title: Add context-length-aware regression gate with confidence-calibrated replays
author: Aisha Patel
release_notes: Introduce a CI hook that partitions prompt sets by context length buckets to detect length-dependent regressions.
Automatic confidence-calibrated replay for failing buckets to reduce false positives.
New dashboard metrics: length_bucket_delta, length_bucket_ci_lower, length_bucket_ci_upper.
description: Motivation: Prompt-set regressions are often non-uniform across context length. A change that looks benign on short prompts can catastrophically degrade quality at longer contexts (or vice versa). This PR adds a new CI gate that partitions prompts by context-length buckets, computes per-bucket metric deltas with bootstrap confidence intervals, and aggregates a risk-weighted score to decide CI pass/fail. The gate also supports a deterministic replay path: when a bucket fails, failing examples are replayed with fixed RNG seeds and higher sample density to produce actionable diffs for engineers. Implementation summary: 1) New hook: eval_hooks/context_length_gate.py implementing bucketing, bootstrapped CIs, and aggregation heuristics; 2) Runtime wiring: register the hook in eval_harness/ci_hooks/__init__.py and expose config under eval_harness/config/ci_hooks.yaml; 3) Tests: unit tests for bucketing and CI calculation in tests/unit/test_context_length_gate.py and an integration smoke test in tests/integration/test_context_length_gate_integration.py; 4) Docs: add a short how-to and examples to docs/ops/ci_hooks.md showing recommended bucket boundaries and guidance for tuning risk weights; 5) CI: extend .github/workflows/eval-ci.yml to run the integration smoke test in the matrix. Checklist: [x] hook implemented and unit tested; [x] integration smoke test added; [x] docs and example config included; [x] metrics emitted for dashboards. Commits: "add context-length gate core logic and configs" | "add deterministic replay harness and sample recorder" | "add unit tests for bucketing and CI math" | "update CI matrix to run context-length smoke test" | "docs: add usage and tuning guide". Changed areas (high level): eval_hooks/context_length_gate.py; eval_harness/config/ci_hooks.yaml; tests/unit/test_context_length_gate.py; tests/integration/test_context_length_gate_integration.py; metrics/emitted_metrics.yaml (length_bucket_delta, length_bucket_ci_lower, length_bucket_ci_upper); .github/workflows/eval-ci.yml; docs/ops/ci_hooks.md; examples/ci/context-length-example.yaml. Testing notes: initial CI run failed due to non-deterministic sampling in the replay harness (flaky test); fixed by seeding the sampler and adding a deterministic sample recorder; re-ran CI: unit suite green, integration smoke initially slow on macos runner -> moved smoke test to linux runner in matrix and reduced sample size for CI while keeping production defaults in examples. Review thread highlights: Jun Park: "Nice approach, can we avoid creating too many buckets by default? Suggest default 3 buckets (short, medium, long) and allow overrides." Author reply (Aisha): "Agreed; default is 3, buckets configurable via ci_hooks.yaml. Updated docs to show examples with 3/5 buckets." Lina Gomez: "The aggregation formula favors long prompts too much in our first iteration; can we expose a per-bucket risk-weight config?" Author: "Added 'risk_weights' per bucket in config and exposed a recommended set. Also added unit tests for weighted aggregation." Ravi Srinivasan: "Please ensure replay artifacts are stored in a reproducible path with metadata (seed, model hash)." Author: "Replay harness now writes replay_*.jsonl along with metadata.json including seed and model_sha. Integration test asserts metadata exists." Approval and merge: Jun approved after requested changes addressed; Lina approved after tests updated; Ravi gave final thumbs-up. CI summary: initial run: fail (flaky replay test) -> fix committed -> rerun: pass for unit and integration on linux and macos runners (macos moved to optional); final CI status: pass. Merge outcome: merged via squash on 2025-09-03 by Jun Park. Why this is different: instead of a single aggregate prompt-level gate this hook explicitly models context-length heterogeneity and uses confidence intervals plus deterministic replays to reduce noise, making it particularly useful for teams serving models where context window behavior varies with sequence length and caching/batching changes may have length-dependent effects.
